set.body:
Scope

Carry the canonical design schema, RowLayout, DesignAudit, and DesignFingerprint across DesignBlock, FmriModel, FitPlan, engine preparation, dense/runwise/LSS/chunk results, and ResultManifest.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] DesignBlock no longer reduces scientific columns to name plus Event/Baseline; it owns or references the canonical structural columns.
- [ ] FmriModel validates response/timepoint alignment against RowLayout before numerical fitting.
- [ ] FitPlan and every supported engine preserve the exact DesignFingerprint and structural coefficient axis.
- [ ] Dense, runwise, LSS, GLS, robust, reduced-rank, and chunk-merged results preserve compatible identity and fail with typed errors on incompatible merges.
- [ ] Result manifests and coefficient-inference provenance use structural column identities while continuing to expose labels for export.
- [ ] Reordered columns remain distinguishable and correctly aligned without relying on global names.
- [ ] Existing inference-scope and covariance-scope evidence is preserved and cannot widen during result conversion or chunk reduction.
- [ ] Values needed by bd-01KX6G9B1ZT10A3214DPA096RZ remain immutable/serializable data rather than captured closures; this issue does not duplicate out-of-core execution.
- [ ] Compatibility adapters are explicit and tested; no second parallel source of column truth appears.
- [ ] Model and fit suites pass on JVM and Scala.js for every supported engine/result path.
set.title: P1.2: propagate structural design identity through model, fit, and result artifacts
